title: Seed-Prover: Deep and Broad Reasoning for Automated Theorem Proving
paper_type_zh: 形式化定理证明模型报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 研究 Lean RLVR、失败轨迹与编译反馈、测试时搜索扩展和形式化数据审计的读者
one_line: Seed-Prover trains a lemma-first Lean policy with binary proof rewards and feedback-rich prompts, then scales from iterative repair to 5,000-conjecture search; Seed-Geometry adds a reported 230M-problem corpus, while only successful proof artifacts are open.
Seed-Prover 以 Lean 二值成功奖励训练 lemma-first 证明策略，并从编译反馈迭代扩展到 5,000 个猜想的重搜索；Seed-Geometry 报告了 2.3 亿问题，但公开仓库仅含成功证明 artifact，不是训练数据发布。
why: It makes the reasoning-data object concrete—formal statements, lemmas, dependencies, failures, compiler feedback, summaries, conjectures, and verified terminal reward—while exposing missing membership, failed trajectories, judge-assisted selection, and search-compute accounting.
inclusion_reason: A frontier formal-reasoning report exposing theorem/lemma/failure/compiler-feedback trajectories, binary Lean RL, proposer curriculum, and three search scales, plus a large but unreleased synthetic geometry recipe.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Automated theorem provers need more than final-answer supervision: they must learn to decompose Lean goals, react to compiler failures, reuse intermediate facts, and spend inference compute on difficult instances. Seed-Prover studies this setting with lemma-first Lean generation, formally checked reinforcement learning, and light/medium/heavy test-time search. The associated Seed-Geometry system addresses auxiliary-construction search in olympiad geometry.

For a data atlas, the central problem is disclosure. The report names theorem sources, record components, rewards, refinement signals, search budgets, and a 230M-problem geometry corpus, but does not release the training records, failed trajectories, checkpoints, LooKeng interface, geometry corpus, or complete compute ledger. The official repository's SeedProver/ directory contains successful proof artifacts, not an open training dataset.

自动定理证明不能只依赖最终答案监督：模型还要学会拆解 Lean 目标、根据编译失败修正证明、复用中间事实，并在困难样本上分配推理算力。Seed-Prover 以 lemma-first Lean 生成、形式验证强化学习和 light/medium/heavy 三档测试时搜索研究这一问题；Seed-Geometry 则面向奥赛几何中的辅助构造搜索。

从数据图谱视角看，核心问题是披露完整性。论文给出了定理来源、记录字段、奖励、修正信号、搜索预算和 2.3 亿几何问题的规模，但没有发布训练记录、失败轨迹、模型 checkpoint、LooKeng 接口、几何语料或完整算力账本。官方仓库的 SeedProver/ 目录是成功证明 artifact，而不是开放训练数据集。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The reusable idea is a feedback-rich formal reasoning object. A record can bind a Lean statement to named lemmas, complete lemma proofs, dependency relations, proof difficulty, whole-proof attempts, failed lemmas, compiler feedback, previous-attempt summaries, and a terminal verification result. Lean supplies a strong binary correctness signal, while an additional undisclosed format penalty encourages lemmas to appear before the main theorem.

At inference, the same object supports progressively wider search. Light repeatedly repairs candidates from compiler feedback; medium isolates failed lemmas and proves them before reinserting them; heavy proposes thousands of conjectures, formally proves or disproves them, builds a fact pool, and ranks retained lemmas for a final proof attempt. This separates formal terminal verification from the learned semantic-relevance judgment used to select heavy-search lemmas.

可复用的核心是“带反馈的形式推理数据对象”。一条记录可以把 Lean 命题与命名 lemma、lemma 完整证明、依赖关系、证明难度、整段证明尝试、失败 lemma、编译器反馈、前次尝试摘要和终止验证结果连接起来。Lean 提供强二值正确性信号，另有一个未披露权重的格式惩罚，鼓励把 lemma 放在主 theorem 之前。

推理阶段沿用同一对象并逐级扩大搜索。Light 根据编译反馈反复修正候选；medium 抽取失败 lemma，先证明再回填；heavy 提出数千个猜想，形式化证明或反证，建立事实池，再筛选 lemma 供最终证明使用。这里必须区分 Lean 的形式终止验证与 heavy 阶段用于语义相关性筛选的未披露 LLM judge。

title: Method
方法
html:
The disclosed pipeline has five linked parts:

  1. Prompt sourcing and curriculum. RL uses cited open formal-math ingredients—Big-Math, NuminaMath, CriticLean, Lean Workbook, and DAPO—plus undisclosed in-house formalizations. Problems with proof rate above 1/4 are excluded as too easy; a proposer creates easier variants for single-pass failures. Exact snapshots, mixtures, counts, and split exclusions are unknown.
  2. Record construction. Prompts randomly expose natural-language hints/proofs, similar or proved lemmas, failed lemmas/attempts, prior summaries, and Lean compiler feedback. Outputs place named lemma blocks before the main theorem; lemma pools can carry statement, complete proof, difficulty, and dependencies. Sampling probabilities and retained/failed record counts are not reported.
  3. Training contract. Multi-stage, multi-task RL based on VAPO uses reward 1 for a Lean-verified proof and 0 otherwise, plus an undisclosed format penalty for lemma-first structure. Difficulty, quality, and maximum output length increase over stages. Optimizer, rollout totals, hardware, reward aggregation, and exact VAPO changes are unknown.
  4. Lean environment. The unreleased LooKeng REPL exposes init_state, run_tac, and verify_proof, supports whole-proof and stepwise interaction, version switching, memory controls, native Lean checking, and asynchronous concurrency. Most reported evaluations use Lean 4.14.0; MiniCTX-v2 uses Lean 4.16.0.
  5. Scaled inference. Light samples Pass@8–16 candidates and refines each up to 8–16 rounds with compiler feedback and self-summary—roughly Pass@64–256 and 1–2 hours. Medium selects failed lemmas, spends an 8×8 light budget on each, inserts proved lemmas into the outer prompt, and can produce proofs over 1,000 lines; aggregate outer limits are unknown. Heavy starts with an empty lemma pool and, by default, 5,000 proposer conjectures (10–50 per call), proves/disproves them using light search, expands from proved facts for days, ranks thousands of facts by proof rate, LLM-judged semantic relevance, and proof length, removes unrelated or short-proof items, retains hundreds, and runs a final medium search.

Seed-Geometry is a separate construction pipeline. Statistics from more than 20 years of olympiad geometry drive a programmatic generator that reports more than 230M unique auxiliary-requiring problems and 38B BPE tokens, generated over more than seven days. A policy maps context to auxiliary constructions; an extended DSL and C++/Pybind11 forward-chaining engine provide the symbolic terminal check. Final inference uses stepwise beam search with GPU policy processes and asynchronous CPU pools. The corpus, engine, policy, DSL, deduplication rule, and training code are not released.

已披露流程可分为五个相连部分：

  1. 提示来源与课程。 RL 使用 Big-Math、NuminaMath、CriticLean、Lean Workbook、DAPO 等公开来源及未披露的内部形式化数据。证明率高于 1/4 的题目被视为过易；对单次证明过难的题目，由 proposer 生成更容易的变体。具体快照、配比、数量和划分排除规则未知。
  2. 记录构造。 提示随机加入自然语言提示/证明、相似或已证 lemma、失败 lemma/尝试、前次摘要和 Lean 编译反馈。输出要求命名 lemma 位于主 theorem 之前；lemma 池可保存陈述、完整证明、难度和依赖。采样概率及保留/失败记录数未报告。
  3. 训练契约。 基于 VAPO 的多阶段、多任务 RL 在 Lean 验证成功时给 1，否则给 0，并叠加一个鼓励 lemma-first 结构的未披露格式惩罚。难度、质量和最大输出长度随阶段上升；优化器、rollout 总数、硬件、奖励组合及 VAPO 改动未知。
  4. Lean 环境。 未发布的 LooKeng REPL 提供 init_state、run_tac、verify_proof，支持整段/逐步交互、版本切换、内存控制、原生 Lean 验证和异步并发。多数评测使用 Lean 4.14.0，MiniCTX-v2 使用 4.16.0。
  5. 扩展推理。 Light 采样 Pass@8–16 个候选，每个结合编译反馈和自摘要修正 8–16 轮，约等于 Pass@64–256，耗时 1–2 小时。Medium 选择失败 lemma，每个投入 8×8 light 预算，把成功 lemma 回填外层提示，可生成超过 1,000 行的证明；外层总限制未知。Heavy 从空 lemma 池开始，默认生成 5,000 个猜想（每次 10–50 个），以 light 证明/反证，连续数日从已证事实扩展；再按证明率、未披露 LLM 的语义相关性和证明长度排序，删除无关或短证明，保留数百个 lemma，最后运行 medium。

Seed-Geometry 是另一条构造管线。系统根据 20 多年奥赛几何统计程序化生成超过 2.3 亿个需要辅助构造的独特问题，共 380 亿 BPE token，生成时间超过七天。策略从上下文预测辅助构造，扩展 DSL 与 C++/Pybind11 前向链推引擎提供符号终止检查；最终以 GPU 策略进程和异步 CPU 池执行逐步 beam search。语料、引擎、策略、DSL、去重规则和训练代码均未发布。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Reported Lean results include 121/155 (78.1%) on past IMO, 100.0% MiniF2F validation and 99.6% test, 331/657 PutnamBench, 30/100 CombiBench, and 81.8% MiniCTX-v2 under light search. Search budgets differ across benchmarks and harder unsolved items are escalated, so these are not uniform-compute comparisons.

For IMO 2025, the deadline-sensitive result is 4/6 during the competition and 5/6 post-competition. P1 completed after the deadline. Human experts translated statements, and fill-in-the-blank formalization used initial solution candidates from Seed1.6-Thinking; these evaluation-time priors must stay visible.

Seed-Geometry reports 43/50 on IMO-AG-50 and solves IMO 2025 geometry P2 in under two seconds. The latter is a natural-language proof artifact rather than a Lean proof, and the geometry model, engine, data, and hardware are unreleased. The official repository releases successful solutions; the inspected P1/P3/P4/P5 Lean files have 4,357/1,969/3,929/767 lines and no textual sorry or admit, but they were not independently compiled.

论文报告的 Lean 结果包括：往届 IMO 121/155（78.1%）、MiniF2F valid 100.0% 与 test 99.6%、PutnamBench 331/657、CombiBench 30/100，以及 light 搜索下 MiniCTX-v2 81.8%。不同基准的搜索预算不同，未解难题还会升级预算，因此不能把这些数字当作统一算力比较。

IMO 2025 必须按截止时间表述为：比赛期间 4/6，赛后 5/6。P1 在截止后完成。题目由人类专家形式化，填空式形式化还使用 Seed1.6-Thinking 生成的初始解答候选；这些评测时先验不能被省略。

Seed-Geometry 报告 IMO-AG-50 为 43/50，并在两秒内解决 IMO 2025 几何 P2。后者是自然语言证明 artifact，不是 Lean 证明；几何模型、引擎、数据和硬件均未发布。官方仓库公开成功解答；检查到的 P1/P3/P4/P5 Lean 文件分别为 4,357/1,969/3,929/767 行，未发现文本形式的 sorry 或 admit，但本次未独立编译。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Seed-Prover's contribution is not merely a stronger final prover. It exposes a coherent data-and-search abstraction in which lemma decomposition, failed proof states, compiler messages, summaries, dependencies, and verified terminal outcomes can become training or inference records. Medium search turns local failures into reusable proved lemmas; heavy search turns proposer conjectures into a growing, formally filtered fact library.

The report also links formal theorem proving to large-scale synthetic geometry generation. Seed-Geometry combines a 230M-problem generator, auxiliary-action policy, and fast symbolic forward chaining, while explicitly reporting that an explored value model was removed because its errors harmed wide search. The novelty is operationally informative, although the key datasets and systems remain closed.

Seed-Prover 的贡献不只是得到更强的最终 prover，而是给出一套连贯的数据—搜索抽象：lemma 分解、失败证明状态、编译消息、自摘要、依赖关系和形式验证终点都可以成为训练或推理记录。Medium 把局部失败转化为可复用的已证 lemma；heavy 则把 proposer 猜想转化为不断扩张、经形式验证筛选的事实库。

报告还把形式定理证明与大规模合成几何生成连接起来。Seed-Geometry 结合 2.3 亿问题生成器、辅助动作策略和高速符号前向链推，并明确说明曾尝试的 value model 因估计误差损害宽搜索而被移除。这些设计披露具有实操价值，但关键数据集和系统仍未开放。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The largest audit gap is release scope. The repository contains reports and successful proof artifacts, not the RL corpus, model checkpoint, failed/refined trajectories, compiler traces, self-summaries, conjecture/lemma pools, judge scores, LooKeng, or Seed-Geometry data and engine. Apache-2.0 for the repository does not establish rights for hidden in-house data, third-party formalizations, generated variants, or the 230M geometry corpus.

Training/evaluation contamination is unresolved. Training draws on open and in-house formalizations; past-IMO mostly adapts Compfiles/MiniF2F, MiniF2F is separately evaluated, and proposer variants can create near duplicates without parent-child splits. MiniCTX-v2's post-November-2024 authorship date is only a partial mitigation because model cutoffs and later RL membership are unknown.

Search compute is not normalized: light is approximately Pass@64–256 over 1–2 hours, but medium outer limits and heavy total calls, tokens, hardware, concurrency, timeouts, and stopping rules are missing. Heavy's LLM relevance judge is an opaque learned selector even though final Lean proofs are formally checked. IMO 2025 also depends on human formalization and Seed1.6-Thinking priors, with 4/6—not 5/6—completed during competition.

最大的审计缺口是发布范围。仓库只有报告和成功证明 artifact，没有 RL 语料、模型 checkpoint、失败/修正轨迹、编译记录、自摘要、猜想/lemma 池、judge 分数、LooKeng 或 Seed-Geometry 数据与引擎。仓库的 Apache-2.0 也不能覆盖隐藏的内部数据、第三方形式化、生成变体或 2.3 亿几何语料的权利。

训练—评测污染尚未解决。训练使用公开及内部形式化；往届 IMO 多由 Compfiles/MiniF2F 改编，MiniF2F 又被单独评测；proposer 变体若无父子划分会形成近重复。MiniCTX-v2 的 2024 年 11 月后创作日期只能部分缓解风险，因为模型截止时间及后续 RL 成员关系未知。

搜索算力未统一核算：light 约为 Pass@64–256、耗时 1–2 小时，但 medium 外层限制及 heavy 的总调用、token、硬件、并发、超时和停止规则缺失。Heavy 的 LLM relevance judge 是不透明的学习式选择器，即使最终 Lean 证明可形式验证。IMO 2025 还依赖人工形式化和 Seed1.6-Thinking 先验，比赛期间完成的是 4/6，而不是 5/6。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
This report is useful for designing RLVR records that preserve more than a scalar reward. A practical schema can retain statement, proof attempt, local lemmas, dependencies, compiler feedback, self-summary, environment version, terminal result, and search lineage. It also motivates curriculum controls based on empirical proof rate and explicit parent IDs for proposer-generated variants.

For evaluation, the paper is a warning to report budget-conditioned results: light, medium, and heavy should be separate settings with samples, refinements, tokens, hardware, wall time, and stop rules. For dataset construction, Seed-Geometry suggests a context-to-auxiliary-action corpus with symbolic verification, but the claimed corpus cannot be reused or audited until its records, generator, DSL, splits, and licenses are released.

该报告适合用于设计“不只保存标量奖励”的 RLVR 记录。一个可操作 schema 可同时保留命题、证明尝试、局部 lemma、依赖、编译反馈、自摘要、环境版本、终止结果和搜索 lineage；它也提示可以按经验成功率控制课程，并为 proposer 变体保留显式父样本 ID。

对评测而言，论文提醒结果必须绑定预算：light、medium、heavy 应作为不同设置，分别报告样本数、修正轮数、token、硬件、墙钟时间和停止规则。对数据构造而言，Seed-Geometry 展示了“上下文—辅助动作—符号验证”的语料方向，但在记录、生成器、DSL、划分和许可证发布前，2.3 亿问题不能被复用或独立审计。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the reward contract exact: Lean success is binary 1/0; the separate lemma-before-theorem formatting penalty has an undisclosed weight and is not proof correctness.
  • Treat the reusable record as statement + lemma/proof/failure + compiler feedback + self-summary + environment + terminal result, not merely a final successful proof.
  • Light means Pass@8–16 candidates with 8–16 refinements each—approximately Pass@64–256 and 1–2 hours; medium gives each failed lemma an 8×8 inner budget.
  • Heavy begins with 5,000 conjectures, grows thousands of facts, and uses an undisclosed LLM relevance judge before a final medium run; formal validity and relevance selection are different contracts.
  • Preserve the IMO 2025 deadline distinction: 4/6 during competition, 5/6 post-competition; human formalization and Seed1.6-Thinking fill-in-the-blank priors also matter.
  • The 230M-problem/38B-token Seed-Geometry corpus and LooKeng are unreleased. The official repository exposes successful proof artifacts, not open training data or failed trajectories.

• 严格区分奖励：Lean 成功是二值 1/0；鼓励 lemma 位于 theorem 前的格式惩罚权重未披露，也不等于证明正确性。
  • 可复用记录应是“命题 + lemma/证明/失败 + 编译反馈 + 自摘要 + 环境 + 终止结果”，而不只是最终成功证明。
  • Light 是 Pass@8–16 个候选、每个 8–16 轮修正，约为 Pass@64–256、1–2 小时；medium 对每个失败 lemma 给 8×8 内层预算。
  • Heavy 从 5,000 个猜想开始，积累数千事实，并在最终 medium 前使用未披露 LLM relevance judge；形式有效性与相关性选择是两种不同契约。
  • 保留 IMO 2025 截止时间差异：比赛期间 4/6，赛后 5/6；人工形式化和 Seed1.6-Thinking 填空先验同样影响解释。
  • Seed-Geometry 的 2.3 亿问题/380 亿 token 语料与 LooKeng 均未发布；官方仓库只公开成功证明 artifact，不是开放训练数据或失败轨迹。

value_zh.html: Seed-Prover 使用未发布的 LooKeng Lean 4 REPL (init_state, run_tac, verify_proof) 进行整证明或逐步交互、版本切换、内存控制、原生验证与异步并发。多数评测使用 Lean 4.14.0；MiniCTX-v2 使用 4.16.0。Seed-Geometry 使用未发布的 C++/Pybind11 前向链接后端，带分布式 GPU 策略进程与异步 CPU 池。

value.html: The principal RL signal is 1 when Lean proves the statement and 0 otherwise, plus an undisclosed formatting penalty encouraging lemmas before the theorem. Heavy search keeps formally proved lemmas but ranks semantic relevance with an undisclosed LLM judge alongside proof rate and length. Geometry terminates through symbolic forward chaining. Reward aggregation, penalty weight, parser, judge calibration, and false-positive audits are unknown.

value_zh.html: 主 RL 信号在 Lean 证明该陈述时为 1，否则为 0，外加未披露的鼓励定理前放置引理的格式惩罚。重搜索保留形式已证引理，但用未披露的 LLM 评审连同证明率与长度对语义相关性排序。几何通过符号前向链接终止。奖励聚合、惩罚权重、解析器、评审校准与假阳性审计未知。

value.html: Theorem success requires a complete proof to verify in the selected Lean/Mathlib environment. Light allows 8–16 refinements per candidate at Pass@8–16; medium gives each selected failed lemma an 8×8 light budget; heavy expands conjectures and proved lemmas for days under undisclosed aggregate limits. Geometry succeeds when forward chaining reaches the goal.

value_zh.html: 定理成功要求完整证明在所选 Lean/Mathlib 环境中验证。轻量允许每个候选在 Pass@8–16 下 8–16 次精炼；中量给每个所选失败引理 8×8 轻量预算；重量在未披露的合计限制下将猜想与已证引理扩展数日。几何在前向链接达到目标时成功。

value.html: Seed-Prover size, base checkpoint, architecture, pretraining corpus, and context window are undisclosed. Seed-Geometry initializes from an unspecified Seed-family model pretrained on code and mathematics; an explored value model was dropped because estimation errors harmed wide search.

value_zh.html: Seed-Prover 的规模、基座 checkpoint、架构、预训练语料与上下文窗口未披露。Seed-Geometry 从未指定的、在代码与数学上预训练的 Seed 族模型初始化；曾探索的价值模型因估计误差损害宽搜索而被放弃。

value.html: No external training proof teacher is disclosed. Human experts create in-house formalizations and IMO 2025 statements. Seed1.6-Thinking supplies initial candidates only for fill-in-the-blank IMO 2025 evaluation formalization. Heavy-search relevance is judged by an undisclosed LLM.

value_zh.html: 未披露外部训练证明教师。人类专家创建内部形式化与 IMO 2025 陈述。Seed1.6-Thinking 仅为填空式 IMO 2025 评测形式化提供初始候选。重搜索相关性由未披露的 LLM 评判。

value.html: Seed-Prover generates lemma-style proofs, failures/refinements, summaries, 10–50 conjectures per proposer call, and easier training variants. Seed-Geometry programmatically generates over 230M problems and uses a policy to propose auxiliary constructions. Checkpoints, prompts, temperatures, beam widths, deduplication, and logs are unknown.

value_zh.html: Seed-Prover 生成引理风格证明、失败/精炼、摘要、每次提议者调用 10–50 条猜想，以及更容易的训练变体。Seed-Geometry 程序化生成超过 230M 个问题，并用策略提议辅助构造。Checkpoints、提示、温度、束宽、去重与日志未知。

value.html: Training randomly varies hints/proofs, related/proved lemmas, failures, summaries, and compiler feedback while increasing difficulty, quality, and output length. Light uses Pass@8–16 with 8–16 refinements; medium gives selected failed lemmas 8×8; heavy starts with 5,000 conjectures, expands from proved lemmas, and sends hundreds of ranked lemmas to a final medium run.

value_zh.html: 训练随机变化提示/证明、相关/已证引理、失败、摘要与编译器反馈，同时提高难度、质量与输出长度。轻量使用 Pass@8–16 与 8–16 次精炼；中量给所选失败引理 8×8；重量从 5,000 条猜想开始，从已证引理扩展，并将数百条排序引理送入最终中量运行。

value.html: Training trajectories are unknown. Light is approximately Pass@64–256 whole-proof samples; medium adds unknown outer attempts and 8×8 inner budgets; heavy begins from 5,000 conjectures but omits total proof, disproof, and refinement calls.

value_zh.html: 训练轨迹未知。轻量约为 Pass@64–256 整证明样本；中量增加未知的外层尝试与 8×8 内层预算；重量从 5,000 条猜想开始，但省略总证明、证伪与精炼调用。

value.html: Unknown for RL, proposer, summarization, relevance judging, and light/medium/heavy inference. Geometry ranks proposals by cumulative negative log likelihood, but temperature and beam width are unknown.

value_zh.html: RL、提议者、摘要、相关性评判与轻量/中量/重量推断均未知。几何按累积负对数似然对提议排序，但温度与束宽未知。

value.html: Exclude RL problems with proof rate above 1/4 and generate easier variants for single-pass failures. Heavy search ranks formally proved lemmas by proof rate, LLM semantic relevance, and proof length, removes unrelated or short-proof lemmas, and retains hundreds for final medium search. Geometry uniqueness and preprocessing are undisclosed.

value_zh.html: 排除证明率高于 1/4 的 RL 问题，并为单次通过失败生成更容易的变体。重搜索按证明率、LLM 语义相关性与证明长度对形式已证引理排序，移除不相关或短证明引理，并保留数百条用于最终中量搜索。几何唯一性与预处理未披露。

value.html: Light uses Pass@8–16 candidates with 8–16 refinements each, approximately Pass@64–256 and 1–2 hours. Medium adds 8×8 light inference per failed lemma and can take hours to days. Heavy begins with 5,000 conjectures, accumulates thousands of facts over days, retains hundreds, then runs medium; total tokens, calls, GPUs, concurrency, and normalized wall time are unknown.

value_zh.html: 轻量使用 Pass@8–16 候选，每个 8–16 次精炼，约 Pass@64–256 与 1–2 小时。中量对每个失败引理增加 8×8 轻量推断，可能耗时数小时至数日。重量从 5,000 条猜想开始，数日内累积数千条事实，保留数百条，然后运行中量；总 tokens、调用、GPUs、并发与归一化墙上时间未知。

value.html: Multi-stage, multi-task RL based on VAPO uses binary Lean success plus a lemma-order format penalty while difficulty, quality, and output length rise. Optimizer, learning rate, batches, rollout counts, KL, stages, hardware, compute, and exact VAPO changes are undisclosed. Seed-Geometry policy optimization is also undisclosed.

value_zh.html: 基于 VAPO 的多阶段、多任务 RL 使用二元 Lean 成功外加引理顺序格式惩罚，同时难度、质量与输出长度上升。优化器、学习率、batches、rollout 计数、KL、阶段、硬件、计算量与精确 VAPO 变更未披露。Seed-Geometry 策略优化也未披露。

value.html: Five cited open ingredients, undisclosed in-house formalizations, proposer variants, and a separate 230M-problem/38B-token geometry corpus are described without source-level counts, snapshots, mixture weights, or reconciliation.

value_zh.html: 描述了五个引用的开放成分、未披露内部形式化、提议者变体，以及单独的 230M 问题/38B-token 几何语料，而无来源级计数、快照、混合权重或对账。

value.html: No immutable train/validation/test or proposer-family split is released. Past-IMO mostly adapts Compfiles/MiniF2F; MiniF2F is separately evaluated. MiniCTX-v2's post-November-2024 date lacks a disclosed model cutoff. Geometry has no released split or overlap ledger.

value_zh.html: 未发布不可变的 train/validation/test 或提议者族划分。Past-IMO 大多改编 Compfiles/MiniF2F；MiniF2F 被单独评测。MiniCTX-v2 的 post-November-2024 日期缺乏已披露的模型截止。几何没有已发布的划分或重叠台账。

value.html: No statement, proof, repository, semantic, or generated-family decontamination is reported. Open formalizations, in-house data, proposer variants, Compfiles/MiniF2F-derived evaluation, and olympiad-derived geometry can overlap directly or structurally.

value_zh.html: 未报告陈述、证明、仓库、语义或生成族去污染。公开形式化、内部数据、提议者变体、源自 Compfiles/MiniF2F 的评测，以及源自奥林匹克的几何可直接或结构上重叠。

items: Only successful proof artifacts are released; failed attempts, compiler traces, summaries, pools, judge scores, and search logs cannot be audited.
Lean correctness is relative to the exact formal statement, imports, axioms, versions, limits, and verifier implementation; LooKeng and complete environments are unreleased.
The undisclosed format penalty may reward surface lemma placement without useful decomposition.
Generated easier variants can leak families across splits; parent-child lineage and near-duplicate audits are absent.
Heavy search uses an opaque LLM relevance judge that may discard valid unconventional lemmas.
Light, medium, and heavy results are not compute-normalized; aggregate samples, tokens, hardware, and stop rules are incomplete.
Past-IMO/MiniF2F source reuse and open plus in-house training lack membership-level contamination auditing.
IMO 2025 used human formalization and Seed1.6-Thinking candidates for fill-in-the-blank items; P1 finished after the deadline.
Seed-Geometry's corpus, policy, DSL, generator, and engine are closed, so uniqueness, overlap, rights, and speed claims are not independently auditable.
The official repository also hosts Seed-Prover 1.5 and Delta-Prover; their claims must not be attributed to this report.
仅发布成功证明产物；失败尝试、编译器轨迹、摘要、池、评审分数与搜索日志无法审计。
Lean 正确性相对于精确形式化陈述、imports、公理、版本、限制与验证器实现；LooKeng 与完整环境未发布。
未披露的格式惩罚可能奖励表面的引理放置而无有用分解。
生成的更容易变体可跨划分泄漏家族；父子谱系与近重复审计缺失。
重搜索使用不透明的 LLM 相关性评审，可能丢弃有效的非常规引理。
轻量、中量与重量结果未经计算归一化；合计样本、tokens、硬件与停止规则不完整。
Past-IMO/MiniF2F 来源复用以及公开加内部训练缺乏成员级污染审计。
IMO 2025 对填空条目使用人类形式化与 Seed1.6-Thinking 候选；P1 在截止日期之后完成。
Seed-Geometry 的语料、策略、DSL、生成器与引擎是封闭的，因此唯一性、重叠、权利与速度声称不可独立审计。
官方仓库还托管 Seed-Prover 1.5 与 Delta-Prover；不得将其声称归因于本报告。

value.html: The official repository is Apache-2.0 and contains reports and successful proof artifacts. Training data, in-house formalizations, variants, failed trajectories, 230M geometry problems, weights, LooKeng, and geometry engine are unreleased; source-level rights remain unknown.

value_zh.html: 官方仓库为 Apache-2.0，含报告与成功证明产物。训练数据、内部形式化、变体、失败轨迹、230M 几何问题、权重、LooKeng 与几何引擎未发布；来源级权利仍未知。
